name: Harisankar Sivankutty
headline: Data Engineering Architect · GenAI
summary: Data and AI engineering leader with over ten years of experience designing, building, and delivering enterprise-scale platforms for clients across telecom, IoT, Biotech, retail, e-commerce, and GenAI. Work sits where architecture meets delivery — turning ambiguous, high-stakes problems into systems that hold up in production. Experience spans distributed processing with Spark and Kafka, the modern data stack (dbt, Great Expectations, DataHub), and multi-cloud architecture across AWS, GCP, Snowflake, and on-premises infrastructure, alongside production GenAI systems built on Retrieval-Augmented Generation, LangChain, and LLM integration. Owns delivery end to end: shaping architecture, mentoring engineers, running quality audits, and keeping stakeholders aligned. Currently a Senior Consultant at Thoughtworks, advising global enterprises on data platforms, GenAI, and cloud-native architecture.

experience.description: Advising and architecting enterprise data platforms for global retail and e-commerce clients — blending modern data stack practices (dbt, Great Expectations, DataHub) with Spark, Kafka, and multi-cloud analytics.

projects.name: Assortment Analytics Platform

Quarterly web-scraping pipelines feeding structured insights into BigQuery
Built an end-to-end framework to transfer data from BigQuery into Snowflake
Enabled data-driven assortment decisions through category gap analysis and white-space detection
Leveraged Snowflake Cortex AI to develop an Agentic AI solution on top of the assortment data

Developed ingestion frameworks for API, streaming, and RDBMS sources
Distributed Apache Spark jobs on AWS EMR; Kafka-based ingestion
